events.title: Full photo audit of 48 Ready to Post Depop drafts
events.detail: Automated sideways/landscape check plus a full visual review of every cover thumbnail. Found and fixed one real issue: a Haggar corduroy pants draft had a yellow tape measure across the pants as its cover photo. Swapped for the clean flat-lay shot already in that listing's photo set.

events.title: Fixed a return policy bug blocking eBay publish
events.detail: Three eBay listings (both boots and the swing analyzer) had silently inherited a "30-Day Seller-Paid Returns (Parts & Accessories)" policy meant for auto parts, which was blocking publish. Fixed to a standard "No Return Accepted" policy.
